title: CarouselSpec
description: Canonical contract for omni-carousel-agent. One deck (Instagram PNG slides, a LinkedIn multi-page PDF, or a panorama canvas) described declaratively so any AI host can author it and any renderer can reproduce it pixel for pixel.

id.description: Stable slug for the carousel (used for output folder names and asset attribution).

title.description: Human title for filenames and the HTML deck header.

platform.description: Target surface. Drives slide-count rules, PDF export and caption limits.

goal.description: Primary objective; the linter checks the deck is structured to earn it.

theme.description: Theme id from spec/themes (editorial, brutal-bento, scrapbook, linkedin-executive) or an absolute JSON path.

accent_override.description: Overrides the theme accent for brand alignment (contrast re-checked by the linter).

mark.description: 1-4 character monogram drawn in the footer.

text.description: The post caption. Platform length rules are enforced by the linter.

cta_link.description: Destination URL for the caption/CTA (never printed inside LinkedIn slide art).

style.description: Composition to plot. Omit to let the engine choose deterministically from the slide seed.

seed.description: Stable seed. Same seed + style always renders the same drawing.

density.description: How much ink the composition spends (0 sparse .. 1 dense).

opacity.description: Global alpha multiplier for the composition.

backdrop.description: Also plot a low-opacity field behind a sparse layout. Default true where it is safe.

art.description: Deterministic generative art (topography, orbital, halftone, isometric, flowfield, constellation, moire, ribbon).

id.description: Optional stable slide id (used for deterministic scrapbook jitter and alt text).

eyebrow.description: Small kicker line above the headline, e.g. "RETENTION 101" or "SLIDE 04".

headline.description: The single dominant line of the slide.

footer_hook.description: Micro-hook (<= 7 words) teasing the next slide.

bg.description: Background token override for this slide.

accent.description: Render this slide on the theme accent surface for emphasis.

alt_text.description: Accessibility description used in captions and the HTML deck.

span.description: Number of consecutive slides sharing one continuous wide canvas (2-6).

index.description: Optional 0-based position inside the span. Inferred from slide order when omitted.

panorama.description: Declares this slide as part of a seamless panorama span.
